'''Sabilon''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] hailed from this territory.
